notes.title: Maguntsche: Chapter Two is Releasing on October 23, 2025!
notes.content:
Maguntsche Chapter Two Releases This Fall!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41465531/b01b229654fa4ceef103c726ec80df5846ffcb95.png"]


Release Date


I am pleased to announce that Maguntsche Chapter Two is scheduled for release on October 23, 2025, at 12:00 PM EST. Initial availability will be for Windows systems, with consideration for additional platform support in future updates. Expanded platform support could include Mac and Linux systems.


Pricing, Launch Discount, & Bundle Availability


Maguntsche Chapter Two will be priced at $9.99, accompanied by a 25% launch discount for a limited promotional period. Furthermore, a "Deluxe Bundle" will be offered, which includes the game's original soundtrack. This bundle is intended to provide additional content for players who wish to further support our development endeavors. The definitive pricing for the Deluxe Bundle is to be determined.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41465531/42c9295ea0f1c025787714593fc020c8724de7ed.png"]
Gameplay Progression


As the launch date approaches, we would like to provide an overview of the anticipated campaign experience. The narrative of Maguntsche Chapter Two is structured into three distinct playable acts, each contributing critically to the story's linear progression. Following the completion of the prologue—which serves as an introductory segment familiarizing players with core gameplay mechanics—player decisions will exert a significant influence on subsequent narrative choices and outcomes.


New & Returning Content & Gameplay


In addition to the primary campaign, the game incorporates elements designed for completionists, including achievements and the reintroduction of the Archives System from the original game. While the prologue will establish foundational mechanics familiar to returning players, the second and third acts introduce new gameplay features such as stealth, looting, and other non-linear gameplay elements.



We anticipate sharing further updates in the coming months as the game's release approaches. We encourage and welcome any questions and feedback from the community. Additionally, dedicated support channels will be established for players to report any feedback or bugs on launch day.



Best Regards,



Kaleb
